migration_22_state_machine.lease_rule: lease renewal or recovery is a state-preserving transactional compare-and-set with expiry and a monotonically increasing stale-worker fencing token
migration_22_state_machine.unknown_outcome_rule: provider_outcome_unknown prohibits repeat provider invocation for the same request and generation identity and reconciles only to verified output_persisted or terminal failed

migration_22_compatibility.legacy_identity_authority: compatibility evidence only; cannot authorize new generation
migration_22_compatibility.migration_failure_rule: any duplicate, contradictory, missing-reference or digest-inconsistent Migration 21 record aborts Migration 22 atomically without silent repair, inference, reclassification or partial migration
migration_22_compatibility.writer_boundary: Migration 22 requires a no-mixed-writer deployment boundary; Migration 21 binaries cannot write Migration 22 state
migration_22_compatibility.post_write_rollback: verified backup restoration or corrective forward migration

migration_22_generation_claim_rule: generation operation claims use only operation-specific terminal semantics; existing workflow-planning states are not reused and requires_reconciliation grants no provider or completion authority

migration_22_control_policy.tenant_ceiling_semantics: quota controls only; not billing or spend accounting

migration_22_locked_requirements: canonical domain-separated idempotency identity binds tenant, brand, Campaign Asset, request identity, generation identity, approved input or snapshot digest, and generation-policy name, version and digest
transactional transitions, bounded leases, expiry and monotonically increasing fencing tokens prevent concurrent or stale workers from acting
deterministic reconciliation classifies incomplete, contradictory or uncertain attempts, advances only permitted states, returns exact stored results and refuses unproved or conflicting state
recovery prevents duplicate attempts, revisions, approvals, receipts and operation-claim final responses while preserving each authoritative owner
retry, timeout, rate-limit, maximum-output-size, circuit-breaker and per-tenant cost boundaries apply before provider invocation

safe observability is limited to correlation identity, tenant and brand scope, policy identity, digests, timestamps, failure category and recovery decision without raw grounding content, secrets or unrestricted prompt logging
